Definition: probably of Hebrew origin (compare H3238); Janna, an Israelite:--Janna.
BiblicalUsage: Janna is one name in the long line Luke traces back from Jesus to Adam. In Luke 3:24 he stands between Melchi and Joseph in the genealogy, one link in a chain that runs through ordinary men nobody else remembers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name like Janna matters because the genealogy is the proof: Jesus came through real people, in a real line, and even the forgotten links count.
